text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...H-How on earth did it come to this...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway, the actual fishing tournament is 
the day after tomorrow, 
so let's spend today getting ready for 
it."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"And so, tada~☆ Here we are at Fishbone, a 
general store that sells fishing gear. 
Let's all pick out some good stuff~."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Huh. Whaaaat...?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"......*sigh*. 
Guess there's nothing left to do but go 
with it!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, look at all these rods~! Oh wow, 
there are some pretty sparkly 
and super cute ones too♡ Hey, can I 
decorate one of these with stickers?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Hm? Hey, Kiseki? 
That stuff over there isn't fishing gear, 
y'know~?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, I'm sorry! I saw some racing shoes 
and just couldn't resist...!! 
We're here for fishing, right! Fishing! 
Okay!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Sky-san said that to catch fish, you 
first need to understand their ecology... 
but going to an aquarium for that is a 
bit—"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Aha, that's wild♡ Hey, Ai-chan, look at 
that! A tuna! 
It is insanely huge! So cool~! Doesn't 
that one look super handsome?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"You can tell the difference? ...Come to 
think of it, tuna is high in protein, 
isn't it. Maybe I'll make that my training 
meal tomorrow."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wait, aren't you looking at it from 
totally different angles?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"This is one of the fishing spots. 
Participants have pretty free rein 
over where they fish, so this isn't the 
only place, though~."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, what are the two of you wearing!? 
What's with those outfits!?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Ehehe~♡ Pretty nice, right? We gotta 
scout the fishing spot, don't we? 
Then why not just dive in to check out 
what kind of fish are here?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Let's go, everybody~~~☆ 
Woohoo~~~! Ahahaha♪"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: "Woohoo~~~, indeed~."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Bright-senpai, you too!?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Bummer, bis ba best~~~~~~☆ 
(Summer is the best~~~~~~☆)"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Bowa~, boba ba bishies~. Bobbee bee ba~. 
(Oh my~, look at all the fishies~. Hello 
there~)"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"(That one's a sardine, that one's a horse 
mackerel... Hehehe. 
Just you wait, I'll be reeling you in on 
tournament day~)"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Phew~☆ That felt amazing~♡ Hey, Ai-chan 
and the rest of you too! 
Go change into your swimsuits~. Then let's 
take some super aesthetic pics, yeah?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, you're wearing your regular gym 
clothes!! 
Where are your swimsuits? You know, the 
summery kind!?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "I didn't bring one, though?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Me neither... Come to think of it, the 
idea of bringing one 
to a summer training camp never even 
crossed my mind~."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? That's terrifying... Y-You're 
kidding, right? ...C-Come on, stop messing 
around~! 
It's summer! Not bringing a swimsuit is 
just... wait, is that really a thing?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"W-Well... we don't need them for 
training, do we?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"...Ughhhhh~~~! What are you two doing~~~! 
When it's finally summer~~~~!"
